_note: Caption style presets for build_captions.py. Mechanics modeled on top clipping accounts: bold display font, 2-4 words on screen at once, the currently-spoken word highlighted, thick outline for legibility over any footage, lower-third placement. Colors are #RRGGBB; build_captions.py converts them to ASS &HBBGGRR&. 'highlight' may be the literal string 'theme_gold' to pull brand/theme.json colors.gold. 'hook_mode': 'persistent' pins the hook banner at the top for the WHOLE clip (competitor format) instead of the default 1.6s flash; 'hook_colors' turns on the per-word multi-color banner (money/numbers gold, conflict words alert, outcome words accent, last word gold_light).

competitor.description: 2026-10-21 competitor format: full-frame crop, big ALL-CAPS hook banner pinned at the top for the whole clip (multi-color key words), centered 3-word captions with the spoken word in gold, thick black stroke. No title card, no badge.

hormozi.description: Classic viral look: UPPERCASE, white words, active word in yellow, fat black stroke.

brand.description: Same mechanics as hormozi but the active word uses the brand gold from theme.json.

clean.description: Minimal sentence-level captions, no per-word highlight. Good for talking-head explainers.
